title: Frozen fixed-slot neural communication in the existing MuJoCo arena
status: fixed after development seed 97 and before final navigation seeds
communication: Existing final modular_curriculum and independently trained silent_task checkpoints; all sender/listener weights frozen; one opening four-symbol message

evaluation.deployment: argmax sender, decisions and movement; final navigation checkpoint only

geometry.standard: scale .95-1.05, translation +/-.25 m, same arena axes, independent receiver yaw
geometry.transformed: scale .85-1.15, translation +/-.45 m, 90/180/270 degree scene rotation, independent receiver yaw
geometry.waypoints: provided public gate/food polylines, at most .35 local meters between points; .18 m reach tolerance
geometry.movement: inherited kinematic arena displacement .2 m and mj_forward; swept wall and hazard checks

criteria.effective_communication: Every paired seed has higher normal task return than its independently trained silent protocol; mean normal-minus-shuffle success >= .30
criteria.reliable_transfer: Mean held-out normal task success >= .95, minimum seed >= .90, zero normal hazard contacts; separately for both splits and geometry families
criteria.execution_fidelity: Every seed normal and oracle execution fidelity >= .99 conditional on correct food and safe route selection
criteria.interpretation: A finite exact-state kinematic MuJoCo transfer with public route scaffolding. It does not establish visual perception, learned route planning, torque locomotion or newly emerged grammar.
